title: JEP 401: Value Objects (Preview) merged to OpenJDK master
summary: JEP 401 introduces Value Objects as a preview feature to Java/OpenJDK, enabling objects to be compared by their content (value semantics) rather than reference identity, with potential performance benefits from value-based representations.
problem_solved: Java historically lacks true value semantics for objects, requiring manual equals()/hashCode() implementation for value-based comparisons.
why_valuable: Provides language-level support for value types, enabling cleaner data modeling, automatic value-based equality, and potential performance optimizations through reduced heap allocation.
